listDirectory(address,bytes32,(bytes32,u.notice: One-call coherent bounded metadata hydration. Bodies require readRecord separately.

lookup(address,bytes32,bytes).notice: Zero is exact absence under an existing live directory; invalid parents revert.

resolve(address,bytes[]).notice: Literal pre-split ASCII segments. No slash parsing, percent decoding or dot traversal.

revisionAt(bytes32,uint64).notice: 1-based revision; an unlinked file's immutable history remains contract-readable.

storeRecord(bytes32,bytes).notice: Generic author-neutral immutable bytes admission, independent of file placement.
